claims: C1 the assistant identifies and follows applicable instructions
C2 in doing so it respects the explicit wording of those instructions
C3 in doing so it respects the underlying intent of those instructions
C4 the section establishes boundaries for autonomous actions
C5 the section emphasizes minimizing unintended consequences

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that applies to the assistant in the current situation
concepts.inference: the section speaks of 'applicable instructions', so a class of instructions that apply must exist

concepts.name: explicit_wording
concepts.gloss: the explicit wording of instruction I is W
concepts.inference: respecting explicit wording presupposes that each instruction has a wording that can be stated

concepts.name: underlying_intent
concepts.gloss: the underlying intent of instruction I is T
concepts.inference: respecting underlying intent presupposes that each instruction has an intent that can be stated

concepts.name: respects_wording
concepts.gloss: the assistant's following of instruction I respects its explicit wording W
concepts.inference: 'respecting' is a relation between the assistant's following and the instruction's wording

concepts.name: respects_intent
concepts.gloss: the assistant's following of instruction I respects its underlying intent T
concepts.inference: 'respecting' is a relation between the assistant's following and the instruction's intent

concepts.name: autonomous_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action the assistant takes without explicit user direction in the current situation
concepts.inference: the section speaks of 'autonomous actions', so a class of such actions must exist

concepts.name: within_boundary
concepts.gloss: autonomous action A falls within the boundaries the section establishes
concepts.inference: 'boundaries for autonomous actions' means some autonomous actions are within the permitted scope and others are not

concepts.name: unintended_consequence
concepts.gloss: C is a consequence of an action that is not intended by the assistant or the instruction
concepts.inference: 'unintended consequences' are consequences that are not intended

concepts.name: minimizes_consequences
concepts.gloss: the assistant's action A minimizes unintended consequences
concepts.inference: 'minimizing unintended consequences' is a property of the assistant's actions

ontology.gloss: the assistant follows applicable instruction I
the assistant's following of instruction I respects its explicit wording W
the assistant's following of instruction I respects its underlying intent T
autonomous action A falls within the boundaries the section establishes
the assistant's action A minimizes unintended consequences

asserts.read_back: following applicable instruction % is required, respecting its explicit wording and underlying intent
acting autonomously as % is permitted only within the boundaries the section establishes
acting autonomously as % is preferred when it minimizes unintended consequences

closure.reason: the clause obliges following applicable instructions but does not forbid following other instructions; silence leaves other following permitted
the clause establishes boundaries for autonomous actions, so autonomous actions outside those boundaries are prohibited
